Method of Attack: Multi-platform malware written in Objective C (macOS), .NET and Delphi (Windows)
Uses same C2 architecture, file paths, behavioral patterns
Heavily abuses Google Drive services for command and control
Installs as binary named 'PLIST' mimicking heavily used applications
Establishes session to Google Drive using hard-coded OAuth2 credentials
Loads components DriveManager, FileManager, GCDTimerManager to manage Google Drive sessions, local directories, and timers
Commands arrive AES-encrypted and include transmitting system info, uploading/downloading files, executing shell commands, setting timers
Launched directly by user or as daemon
Attack Vector: Malware installed as binary mimicking legitimate apps
Use of Google Drive with hard-coded OAuth2 credentials for C2 communication
